definition.description: The engine of record. Diffs the Outlook calendar view against the sync map and applies creates, updates and deletes through flow 2. Runs on a schedule because the Outlook change trigger is documented to drop events, fire spuriously and lag up to an hour; every guarantee this solution makes is delivered here, so a missed trigger costs latency and never correctness.

Every_15_minutes.description: Worst-case sync latency. Recurrence intervals cannot be driven by an environment variable, so changing this means editing the flow. Roughly five API calls per run plus one per change.

Init_Skip.description: Paging cursor. Get calendar view returns at most 256 rows per call.

Init_SeenKeys.description: Correlation keys present in this Outlook read. Anything active in the map and absent here is a deletion candidate.

Init_Applied.description: Mutations performed this run. Compared against MaxMutationsPerRun to stay inside Google's 100-calls-per-60-seconds budget.

Page_Outlook_Calendar_View.description: Get calendar view expands recurring series into occurrences, which is essential because the Google connector cannot create recurring events at all. It caps at 256 rows, so page until a short page comes back.

Append_Page.description: Appends per item: SetVariable cannot reference its own variable, and no append-array action exists.

Guard_Outlook_Read.description: Recorded so the log shows how many events the read produced. An unexpectedly small number is the signature the delete circuit breaker exists to catch.

Get_Map_Rows.description: Active rows only, in one REST call rather than one SharePoint action per item.

For_Each_Outlook_Event.description: Sequential on purpose: concurrent branches would race the Applied counter and blow through the Google throttle cap.

Compose_Key.description: Keyed on iCalUId, not the Graph event id: Outlook rewrites the id when an invitation is accepted, which would otherwise mirror the meeting twice.

Compose_BodyFingerprint.description: Graph's bodyPreview is already plain text; the expression language has no regex, so only line breaks and tabs are flattened. Matches o365gcal.normalize.body_fingerprint exactly.
Compose_BodyFingerprint.inputs: @concat(string(length(trim(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(item()?['body'], ''), decodeUriComponent('%0A'), ' '), decodeUriComponent('%0D'), ' '), decodeUriComponent('%09'), ' ')))), ':', substring(trim(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(item()?['body'], ''), decodeUriComponent('%0A'), ' '), decodeUriComponent('%0D'), ' '), decodeUriComponent('%09'), ' ')), 0, min(256, length(trim(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(item()?['body'], ''), decodeUriComponent('%0A'), ' '), decodeUriComponent('%0D'), ' '), decodeUriComponent('%09'), ' '))))))

Compose_Description.description: Attendees are rendered as text, not attached as real Google attendees: a non-empty Google attendee list makes Google email an invitation to every Outlook attendee from the user's own account.

Decide.description: No row or no Google id -> Create. Fingerprint moved -> Update. Otherwise NoOp, the common case, costing zero Google calls. Deletion is decided after the loop from rows absent in this read: the calendar view has no cancellation flag.

Apply_If_Needed.description: Second clause is the throttle cap: once the budget is spent the rest is counted and left for the next run rather than failing mid-batch.

Run_Apply_Event.description: Child flow 2 is the only writer to Google, which is what lets this flow and flow 1 run concurrently without duplicating events.

Count_Applied.description: Counts a failed apply too: it consumed budget and must not be retried into the same throttle window.

Record_Change.description: Recorded after the write is counted, so the notification lists what was attempted this run even if a single event failed.

Compose_Payload.description: The complete occurrence handed to child flow 2, which is the only writer.
Compose_Payload.inputs: @setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(json('{}'), 'googleEventId', coalesce(outputs('Find_Map_Row')?['GoogleEventId'], '')), 'mapItemId', string(coalesce(outputs('Find_Map_Row')?['Id'], ''))), 'fingerprint', outputs('Compose_Fingerprint')), 'summary', outputs('Compose_Subject')), 'start', item()?['startWithTimeZone']), 'end', item()?['endWithTimeZone']), 'description', outputs('Compose_Description')), 'location', if(outputs('Compose_Hidden'), '', coalesce(item()?['location'], ''))), 'isAllDay', coalesce(item()?['isAllDay'], false)), 'outlookEventId', coalesce(item()?['id'], '')), 'outlookICalUId', coalesce(item()?['iCalUId'], '')), 'seriesMasterId', coalesce(item()?['seriesMasterId'], '')), 'myResponse', coalesce(item()?['responseType'], 'none'))

Circuit_Breaker.description: Deletion is the only irreversible operation here, and it is inferred from absence. A throttled response, an expired token and a genuine mass cancellation all look identical from this side, so a batch that is both large in absolute terms and a large share

parameters.parameters/body: @setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(json('{}'), 'Title', variables('RunId')), 'Timestamp', utcNow()), 'FlowName', '3 Reconcile'), 'Level', 'Error'), 'Operation', 'Skip'), 'Message', concat('Refused ', string(length(variables('Deletes'))), ' deletion(s): ', string(div(mul(length(variables('Deletes')), 100), max(length(variables('ActiveRows')), 1))), '% of ', string(length(variables('ActiveRows'))), ' active mirrored events, over the ', string(parameters('MaxDeletePercent (o3gc_MaxDeletePercent)')), '% safety threshold. This usually means the Outlook read failed or returned partial data rather than a genuine mass cancellation. No events were removed from Google. Outlook returned ', string(outputs('Guard_Outlook_Read')), ' events this run.'))

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: O365GCal: mass deletion refused - action needed
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
The calendar mirror wanted to delete @{length(variables('Deletes'))} of @{length(variables('ActiveRows'))} mirrored events in one run, which is over the safety threshold.

Nothing was removed from Google.

Outlook returned @{outputs('Guard_Outlook_Read')} events for the sync window. If that number looks wrong, the Outlook read failed rather than the meetings being cancelled - check the Office 365 Outlook connection and run the flow again.

If the cancellations are genuine, raise MaxDeletePercent for one run and let it complete, then set it back.

Log_Run_Summary.description: A run truncated by the throttle cap must never read as a complete one.

parameters.parameters/body: @setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(json('{}'), 'Title', variables('RunId')), 'Timestamp', utcNow()), 'FlowName', '3 Reconcile'), 'Level', if(greater(variables('Deferred'), 0), 'Warn', 'Info')), 'Operation', 'NoOp'), 'Message', concat('Reconcile complete. Outlook events: ', string(outputs('Guard_Outlook_Read')), '; active map rows: ', string(length(variables('ActiveRows'))), '; mutations applied: ', string(length(variables('Applied'))), '; deferred to next run: ', string(variables('Deferred')), '.'))

Stamp_Health.description: The heartbeat the watchdog reads. Without it, a flow that is switched off or whose connection expired produces no signal at all.

Check_Map_Read_Complete.description: A full page means the map read may be short. Continuing would treat unseen rows as unmirrored and mirror those events again, so the run stops instead.

parameters.parameters/body: @setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(json('{}'), 'Title', variables('RunId')), 'Timestamp', utcNow()), 'FlowName', '3 Reconcile'), 'Level', 'Error'), 'Operation', 'Skip'), 'Message', concat('Aborted: the sync map read returned a full page (', string(length(variables('MapRows'))), ' rows), so it may be incomplete. Continuing would duplicate events whose rows were not read. Prune the map or raise the page size.'))

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: O365GCal: sync paused - bookkeeping list too large
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
The sync map now holds at least @{length(variables('MapRows'))} active rows, which is SharePoint's read limit. A read that large may be incomplete.

Syncing has paused rather than continue on partial data. Continuing would treat the rows it could not see as never having been mirrored, and create a second copy of those events.

The watchdog prunes old rows automatically once a day. If this persists, reduce WindowFutureDays or MapRetentionDays.

Stop_Run.description: Fails deliberately so the run shows as failed and the watchdog escalates, rather than reporting success having done nothing.

runError.message: Sync map read may be incomplete; refusing to sync.

Filter_Active_Rows.description: Rows we actually created something for. The denominator for the delete circuit breaker.

inputs.where: @and(not(contains(variables('SeenKeys'), item()?['Title'])), and(greaterOrEquals(item()?['OccurrenceStartUtc'], addDays(utcNow(), mul(-1, int(parameters('WindowPastDays (o3gc_WindowPastDays)'))))), lessOrEquals(item()?['OccurrenceStartUtc'], addDays(utcNow(), int(parameters('WindowFutureDays (o3gc_WindowFutureDays)'))))))

Filter_Absent_Rows.description: Active rows Outlook did not report, still inside the window. Out-of-window rows are excluded: ageing past the window is not a cancellation.

Notify_Changes.description: Only when something actually changed. A notification that fires on every quiet run is the fastest way to teach someone to filter these emails away.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Mirrored just now

    @{join(body('Select_Changes_Html'), '')}

Outlook events in the window: @{outputs('Guard_Outlook_Read')}. Mirrored events tracked: @{length(variables('ActiveRows'))}.@{if(greater(variables('Deferred'), 0), concat(' Deferred to the next run: ', string(variables('Deferred')), '.'), '')}

Turn this off by setting NotifyOnChange to no; the daily digest covers the same ground once a day.

Catch_Reconcile.description: Records the failure and bumps the consecutive-failure counter so the watchdog escalates after three.

parameters.parameters/body: @setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(json('{}'), 'Title', variables('RunId')), 'Timestamp', utcNow()), 'FlowName', '3 Reconcile'), 'Level', 'Error'), 'Message', 'Reconcile failed; see DetailJson.'), 'DetailJson', substring(string(result('Try_Reconcile')), 0, min(8000, length(string(result('Try_Reconcile'))))))
